monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The used-accessory guide adds an independent no-go screen, exact-object packet, adjusted-cost comparison, secondhand acceptance card, prominent gear-hub path, and contextual routes into existing model-specific buying guides. No merchant, marketplace, product, model, price, coupon, ranking, product image, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: The harvest record, secondhand buying screen, and sitemap gate use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. The canonical sitemap remained pending with one error and the legacy endpoint showed two errors, so today's only Data-led item adds URL-and-lastmod parity, page-date matching, nonfuture-date, robots-directive, and legacy-payload publication gates. Stem Cell CBG at 19 impressions, one click, and position 6.0 was not reinforced again because it was materially expanded October 15. One-impression legal queries, Montana cannabis at two impressions, About at 11 impressions, Contact at nine impressions, and Blue Dream terms around positions 48–70 were ignored as too small, navigational, or outside the supported 4–20 opportunity range.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy New York post-harvest batch log with a room-readiness matrix, durable identity chain, repeatable environment and condition log, narrow mass-change math, container-transition record, hard-stop gate, and final storage/disposition record grounded in OCM, EPA, and university-extension sources. Reciprocal links strengthen the home-grow planner and pest/mold IPM cluster. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
